WITH asof AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' d),
mem AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.member_key, m.tier FROM dim_member m, asof WHERE m.join_date <= asof.d AND asof.d BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to),
act AS (
  SELECT dm.member_id,
    count(*) lines,
    sum((NOT f.staff_purchase_flag)::int) nonstaff_lines,
    sum((w.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled')::int) noncancel_lines,
    sum((NOT f.staff_purchase_flag AND w.status IS DISTINCT FROM 'cancelled')::int) clean_lines,
    sum((f.net_amount>0)::int) pos_lines
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key=f.member_key
  LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND f.channel_code='WB'
  , asof
  WHERE f.sale_date > asof.d - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND f.sale_date <= asof.d
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT mem.tier, count(*) enrolled, count(a.member_id) active_any, sum((a.nonstaff_lines>0)::int) active_nonstaff, sum((a.noncancel_lines>0)::int) active_noncancel, sum((a.clean_lines>0)::int) active_clean, sum((a.pos_lines>0)::int) active_pos
FROM mem LEFT JOIN act a USING(member_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-21' AS cutoff),
mem AS (SELECT m.member_id, m.tier FROM dim_member m, p WHERE m.join_date <= p.cutoff AND p.cutoff BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to),
act AS (
  SELECT dm.member_id, count(*) lines, sum((NOT f.staff_purchase_flag)::int) nonstaff_lines, sum((f.net_amount>0)::int) pos_lines,
         sum((f.sale_date > p.cutoff - INTERVAL 6 MONTH)::int) l6
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key=f.member_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.cutoff - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND f.sale_date <= p.cutoff
  GROUP BY 1)
SELECT mem.tier, count(*) enrolled, count(a.member_id) active_any, sum((a.nonstaff_lines>0)::int) active_nonstaff, sum((a.pos_lines>0)::int) active_pos, sum((a.l6>0)::int) active_6m
FROM mem LEFT JOIN act a USING(member_id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH p AS (
  SELECT period_end_date AS cutoff FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period = 8
),
members_at_cutoff AS (
  SELECT m.member_id, m.tier
  FROM dim_member m, p
  WHERE m.join_date <= p.cutoff AND p.cutoff BETWEEN m.valid_from AND m.valid_to
),
purchasers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT dm.member_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_member dm ON dm.member_key = f.member_key, p
  WHERE f.sale_date > p.cutoff - INTERVAL 1 YEAR AND f.sale_date <= p.cutoff
)
SELECT m.tier, count(*) AS active_members
FROM members_at_cutoff m JOIN purchasers USING (member_id)
GROUP BY m.tier
ORDER BY CASE m.tier WHEN 'Basic' THEN 1 WHEN 'Silver' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
